message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).

| Zone | Standard UTC offset | Daylight‑Saving UTC offset |
|------|---------------------|----------------------------|
| Los Angeles | UTC‑8 | UTC‑7 |
| Berlin | UTC +1 | UTC +2 |

Because both regions observe daylight saving at roughly the same times, the 9‑hour difference stays constant throughout the year. So when it’s noon in Berlin, it’s 3 a.m. the same day in Los Angeles.

So difference is 9 hours during standard time (Los Angeles UTC-8 vs Berlin UTC+1 => +9). During daylight saving, Los Angeles UTC-7 vs Berlin UTC+2 => +9 as well.
